title: Terms and conditions
subtitle: Your files are not stored by us!

sections.heading: What AnyDoc keeps
points: The file you upload, the text read from it, and a search index of its passages. The index is built on this machine.
Your conversations: the questions you ask and the answers given.

sections.heading: What deleting a conversation removes
points: The conversation, with all its questions and answers.
If it is the last conversation about a document, the document too: the original file, its text and its search index.
If other conversations are still about the same document, the document stays until the last of them is deleted.
Deletion is permanent. Nothing is hidden or kept to restore later, and it can’t be undone.
A conversation can’t be deleted while its document is still being processed.

sections.heading: What stays after deleting
points: An activity record that a deletion happened: when, and internal ids. It holds no file content, questions or answers.
If this installation keeps database backups, copies may remain in them until those backups expire.

sections.heading: Services outside AnyDoc
points: To answer, passages from your document and your question are sent to the AI model you choose (Google Gemini or Groq).
When a web search runs, a search query is sent to the search service (Tavily or DuckDuckGo).
Those services keep data under their own terms. Deleting in AnyDoc can’t remove what they hold.
